content: Canonical ring system + Claude exemption shipped on branch feat/antigravity-connector (HQ commits 62ed88c, a7d0cc6). bridge_core/rings.py is now the single source of truth: CANONICAL_RING_1 (33 reads), CANONICAL_RING_2 (10 governed writes), CANONICAL_COMMIT_TARGETS, and is_full_trust() — the Claude exemption (claude-/anthropic- substrates bypass ring governance, full surface). grok_bridge/rings.py and openai_bridge/interceptor.py now source the base scope from canonical, ending the prior 33/31 and 11/10 drift; grok keeps its extensions (grok_welcome, probe_ring2_dispatch). The Antigravity/Gemini connector (clients/antigravity_connector/bridge_setup.py) is now ring-governed: governed list = 41 tools (zero Ring 3 leak), Ring 1 proxied to spawned sovereign, Ring 2 -> pending proposal under ~/.sovereign/antigravity_connector/ (verified NOT reaching the chronicle), Ring 3 refused; Claude full-trust bypass verified on both list and call paths. Tests: grok smoke 62/62; openai 25/28 == pre-existing baseline (3 commit-path mocking failures, identical with/without the change). OPEN FOLLOW-UP GATE: openai bridge has no local handler for verify_proposal/list_bridge_proposals (grok serves them from bridge_core; openai uses its own pending_writes), so they are excluded from openai advertising until wired in openai_bridge/mcp_filtered.py — do this before the next openai bridge restart. Merge to main + push to origin remain gated on Anthony.
